currentCard.prompt: Какой предмет верхней одежды обычно застёгивается на молнию, имеет передние карманы и трикотажные манжеты и пояс?

answers.note: Merriam-Webster определяет coat как верхнюю одежду для верхней части тела; длина и фасон зависят от моды и назначения.
Бомбер — обычно кожаная куртка на молнии с передними карманами, трикотажными манжетами и поясом.

literal.prompt: Какой предмет верхней одежды обычно застёгивается на молнию, имеет передние карманы и трикотажные манжеты и пояс?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS for the full usually construction profile: BOMBER JACKETL36 explicitly combines zip closure, front pockets, knitted cuffs AND knitted waistband. The Russian question asks which ordinary outerwear type typically has that complete construction, not which object could ever be customised to have one feature. In the actual row, Бомбер is the conventional type defined by that ribbed-cuff/waist combination; Пальто is the general coat type, Плащ-дождевик the rain-protective coat, and Парка the warm/hooded type. Single shared zipper/pockets or a hypothetical hybrid is insufficient to answer the full typical-style question. The key is supported by the distinctive construction bundle, not mere absence of a feature in another entry.

absoluteLevel.assessment: Recognising a familiar bomber from observable cuffs/waist/zip construction is ordinary adult wardrobe knowledge, including the broad adult groups familiar with casual jackets. It requires neither a rare date, aviation history, English word meaning nor a specialist sewing term; манжеты and трикотажный пояс are common visible clothing details. Alternatives are comparable familiar outerwear forms.
